title: Prospective forecast underfit diagnosis

evaluated_cohort.duplicate_keys: Phase 119 blocks ambiguous composite keys; no duplicate rows in the evaluated cohort.

forecast_magnitude_and_direction.interpretation: The point forecast moves only about 5.1% as far as the realized move on average and its direction is approximately coin-flip on this cohort. This is consistent with an under-dispersed/near-baseline forecast, not a useful directional signal.

root_cause_assessment.confirmed: The current prospective output is strongly compressed toward the previous-close baseline and has no demonstrated directional edge.
root_cause_assessment.not_proven: The 17-session evidence does not establish which training feature or estimator causes the compression.
code_review_observations: The production close target is a next-session return, but the pooled model trains with MAE loss and a fixed 70/30 HistGradientBoosting/ExtraTrees ensemble.

The shared feature set contains several raw price-scale features (SMA20, SMA50, EMA20, EMA50, MACD) alongside normalized features; this may impair cross-symbol pooling and should be tested with scale-normalized features.
The 17-session sample is too small to justify per-symbol exclusions, a production feature change, or a new prediction calibration.

next_research_experiment.scope: shadow-only chronological replay; retain current model as control
candidates: Normalize price-level indicators by contemporaneous adjusted close (for example SMA/close-1, EMA/close-1, MACD/close) while retaining return and volatility features.
Compare current MAE ensemble with a regularized return model and a zero-return/previous-close baseline.
Measure forecast dispersion, signed bias, directional accuracy, MAPE, and performance by volatility regime on untouched chronological sessions.
Require improvement across multiple chronological folds and retain all existing independent governance gates.

caveat: This is a diagnostic artifact, not a causal proof or a production model change. Realized-move regime segments are ex-post descriptions and cannot be used as live filters.
